PHYSICS
 CONFIDENTIAL PRACTICAL
 JULY –AUGUST 2026
 Each student will require the following apparatus
 QUESTION 1
 − A clean burette ( with tap and not clip)
 − Retort stand
 − Two clamps and 2 bosses
 − A metre rule
 − Water
 − 100ml beaker
 − A stopwatch
 QUESTION 1 B
 -A boiling tube.
 -Some dry sand.
 -A liquid in a measuring cylinder labelled L.(water)
 -Half metre rule.
 -A vernier calipers (to be shared)
 -A weighing machine
 -Tissue paper.
 -A measuring cylinder.
 QUESTION 2
 -A micrometer screw gauge ( to be shared)
 -A voltmeter ( 0- 3 or 0-5 W)
 -Ammeter ( 0- 1A)
 -nicrome wire SWG 28-32 ( d = 0.35 mm) mounted on a mmscale with the ends labeled AB.
 - A switch
 - A jockey / A connecting with a of approx 50 cm Length having a crocodile clip attached to one
 end.
 -One new dry cell
 - At least eight connecting wires with clips attached to one end
